description: Implementation of OrderDao interface for data access operations related to Order entities, including methods for retrieving an order by ID and listing orders with criteria such as store, customer, and pagination.

classes.name: OrderDaoImpl
classes.description: Repository class providing data access implementation for Order entities, extending generic DAO and implementing OrderDao interface, with methods for fetching orders by ID and listing with criteria.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an Order entity by its identifier, eagerly fetching related order products, totals, and history.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders for a specific store based on provided criteria, including filtering, sorting, and pagination.
